classification: Direct visual inspection of all36 original PNGs and35 read-only full-page crops.
limits: Sticky header and fixed mobile contact bar appear across some element screenshots and at the initial viewport boundary in full-page captures. Those capture overlays are disclosed; unobscured full-page segments, other widths and DOM were cross-checked.
The capture evidence does not demonstrate every possible scroll position or every focus target.
Mobile viewports are desktop Chromium320/390 CSS-pixel layouts, not physical iOS/Android or screen-reader testing.
No live public-domain browser session, external merchant checkout, telephone call, stock, final shipping cost or fulfillment test was performed.
reviewer: Independent Gwangsan actual-artifact and pixel reviewer
